description:
NOTE: THIS EVENT WILL TAKE PLACE AT THE LOS ALTOS COMMUNITY CENTER GRAND OAK ROOM

 Join us for this special Happy Birds program presented by the Los Altos Library Commission.

 The Happy Birds Show includes over 25 amazing tricks performed by the show's famous talking and singing parrots! It is fast-paced and interactive fun for the whole family.

 Arrive at 10:30 to decorate a book bag or bucket hat. Happy Birds will begin at 11am.
